task: Instance segmentation via full-foreground and touching-contact heads
purpose: Validation-selected pilot before the locked ten-seed contact-boundary study
augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
loss: foreground Dice+BCE plus 0.5 times contact-boundary Dice+positive-weighted BCE
selection: highest validation Caicedo object-F1; contact threshold selected on validation only
postprocessing: remove predicted contact pixels from foreground to form markers, then assign all foreground pixels to their nearest marker
primary_endpoint: Caicedo average object F1 over IoU thresholds 0.50 to 0.90
